The driver for `zephyr,native-sim-gpio` is enabled by the Kconfig option `CONFIG_GPIO_NATIVE_SIM`. This option is defined as a `bool` without a `default y` in `drivers/gpio/Kconfig.native_sim`, meaning it defaults to `n` if not explicitly set. While `CONFIG_GPIO=y` is present in `prj.conf`, `CONFIG_GPIO_NATIVE_SIM` is not automatically selected by `CONFIG_GPIO`.

Adding this configuration to `prj.conf` will resolve the `undefined reference` linker error.
